title: REQ · Empty and over-length text are rejected with identifiable messages
summary: Validation alerts have test ids and tests prove no POST is sent
description: Context: blank and over-limit alerts exist with ids but no test ids. Desired behavior: add test ids; tests assert messages and absence of POST. Why: SG-8.5 validation coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty text, when the form is submitted, then contribution-validation-blank shows 'Enter an idea first' and no POST is made
Given 501 characters, when typed, then contribution-validation-limit shows 'Too long: 501 / 500', Send is disabled and no POST is made
Given exactly 500 characters, when sent, then contribution-validation-limit is absent and POST is made
